attributes.Name: Purdue Memorial Union
attributes.description: The Purdue Memorial Union was added onto in 1936. This addition expanded the building to the west and north and expanded the existing ballroom. The new east wing faced Grant street and contained a browsing library, student activity rooms, music rooms, a bowling alley, game room, and lounging grill. This addition also expanded the basement of the Union.

attributes.Name: Purdue Memorial Union Club
attributes.description: The Purdue Memorial Union was added onto again in 1955. This addition provided 140 additional rooms for the Union Club Hotel and more than doubled the available rooms.

attributes.Name: Purdue Memorial Union
attributes.description: Phase two of the construction of the Purdue Memorial Union began in 1929.

attributes.Name: Purdue Memorial Union
attributes.description: A major addition was added to the Purdue Memorial Union in 1940. During this expansion, the west wing was constructed which doubled the size of ballroom space (added the North ballroom) and created additional dining rooms and student organization offices. Construction of the east wing doubled the Union Club living facilities to 126 rooms and the bowling alley was also renovated.
